name: Freyja
title: Lady of the Vanir
description: Freyja is one of the most prominent goddesses in Norse mythology, associated with love, beauty, fertility, sex, war, gold, and seiðr (magic). She is a member of the Vanir, a group of gods associated with fertility and prosperity. Freyja is known for her incredible beauty and her fierce independence. She possesses the Brísingamen necklace and rides a chariot pulled by two cats. She receives half of those who die in battle in her hall Fólkvangr, while Odin receives the other half in Valhalla. Freyja is also a practitioner of seiðr, a form of Norse magic, and is said to have taught this art to Odin himself.

attributes.appearance: Stunningly beautiful goddess with golden hair, often wearing the golden Brísingamen necklace, riding a chariot pulled by cats or the boar Hildisvíni
attributes.personality: Passionate, independent, powerful, sensual, fierce in both love and war
